_comment: Phase 13 golden invariant — post-normalization shape of a fresh-app RunContext as emitted by RunContextBuilder.build('completed'). Volatile fields (runId, timestamp) are normalized in the test comparator (see pipeline-checkpoint-unchanged.test.ts#normalizeRunContext and cli/__tests__/helpers/phase-13-harness.ts#normalizeRunContext). Regenerated in plan 13-03 to match the actual RunContext schema (the 13-01 draft targeted a hypothetical shape with schemaVersion/startedAt/updatedAt/completedAt/errors that RunContextBuilder has never produced). Phase 13 is pure instrumentation — this fixture locks the fresh-app shape so any Phase 14+ change that alters it will fail this test.
